title: Codex plugin for Claude Code lets you invoke Codex model directly inside your Claude Code terminal
description:
OpenAI just dropped an official plugin for Claude Code. Codex plugin for Claude Code lets you invoke OpenAI's Codex model directly inside your Claude Code terminal. Just had Claude write a massive feature? Run slash codex review to have Codex double-check the work. Want to go harder? Use adversarial review to make Codex act like a ruthless senior engineer and aggressively pressure-test your code before merging! Two rival AIs, one terminal. 

https://github.com/openai/codex-plugin-cc

#github #opensource
